constraints.source_text: Students are required to take ECON 203 , ECON 205 , ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 317 , ECON 318 and four economics elective courses.
constraints.description: Students must complete six specified core economics courses plus four economics elective courses.

constraints.source_text: Of the four elective courses (300 level or above) a minimum of two must be economics courses at the 400 level or higher.
constraints.description: At least two of the four elective courses must be at the 400 level or higher.

details.scope: four economics elective courses (300 level or above)

constraints.source_text: The remaining two economics courses must be approved by the department’s director of undergraduate studies.
constraints.description: The remaining two elective courses require approval by the director of undergraduate studies, with no defined list provided.

constraints.source_text: MATH 118gx or MATH 125 is required for the major
constraints.description: Students must complete either MATH 118gx or MATH 125.

constraints.source_text: Majors are also required to take at least one two-unit course on computing chosen from TAC 101 or CSCI 101L.
constraints.description: Students must complete at least one two-unit computing course chosen from TAC 101 or CSCI 101L.

unclassified.source_text: students are advised to meet the requirement by their sophomore year
unclassified.why: This is an advisory recommendation about timing, not a binding requirement.
